explanation: Searched Mathlib for any other declaration stating the `mulVec`-against-`vecCons` identity: grepped for `mulVec_cons`, `mulVec_(cons|snoc|head|tail)`, `Fin.cons`/`Fin.snoc` combined with `*ᵥ` or `ᵥ*`, `vecHead ∘`/`vecTail ∘`, and `Matrix.mulVec` lemmas with `Fin.succ` in Data/Matrix/Mul.lean and LinearAlgebra/Matrix/*. The only related results are the dual ones in the same file: `Matrix.vecMul_cons` (line 327, `v ᵥ* of (vecCons w B) = vecHead v • w + vecTail v ᵥ* of B`, consuming the matrix rather than the vector) and `Matrix.cons_mulVec` (line 350, expanding the matrix instead of the vector); neither states this result, and deriving it from `vecMul_cons` would require transposition reasoning of some substance. No general `Fin.cons`-based mulVec lemma exists to specialize, so no duplicate or single-declaration special case was found.
